s.note: Mowgli climbing the cliff to get Baloo's honey
s.how: Beat 250g ricotta with 2 tbsp honey until light. Toast thick slices of sourdough, cut into fingers and spread with the ricotta. Drizzle with more honey and scatter with crushed walnuts. A bear would steal the lot.

Cut a mango, half a pineapple and 2 bananas into chunks and toss with a drained can of lychees. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a little salt mixed with chilli flakes. Pile it high in a big bowl for a temple full of monkeys.

m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with ground cumin, crushed garlic, oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Serve on a board with warm flatbread and garlic yoghurt for the whole pack.

w.how: Boil 200g sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 2 tbsp honey to 150C. Take off the heat and whisk in 2 tsp bicarb soda so it foams up. Pour into a lined tin and leave to set. Break into chunks and dip half of each in melted dark chocolate.

d.how: Blend 2 mangoes with 300g Greek yoghurt, 250ml cold milk and a pinch of ground cardamom until smooth. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Cool and thick, made for a hot day at the Peace Rock.
